name: Brayne WhatsApp Connect
description: Adds a floating WhatsApp contact button with a welcome message, preset replies, configurable position and colours, and business-hours open/closed state.
author: Brayne Smart solutions Corp

enabled.label: Show the WhatsApp button
enabled.description: Turn the floating contact button off without uninstalling the plugin.

whatsappNumber.label: WhatsApp number
whatsappNumber.description: International format without spaces or brackets, e.g. 15551234567 or +233201234567. Leave empty to hide the button.

welcomeMessageOpen.label: Welcome message while open
welcomeMessageOpen.description: Prefills the chat when a visitor opens the button during business hours.
welcomeMessageOpen.default: Hi! I'd like to know more about your services.

welcomeMessageClosed.label: Welcome message while closed
welcomeMessageClosed.description: Prefills the chat when the business is closed. Falls back to the open message until you set it.
welcomeMessageClosed.default: Hi! I'd like to know more about your services.

presetMessages.label: Preset messages
presetMessages.description: One per line. Each becomes a tappable quick reply above the message box.
presetMessages.default:
I'd like a quote
Are you available this week?
Please send me your pricing

buttonPosition.label: Button position
buttonPosition.description: Corner the button sits in. It moves above the browser's own UI on small screens.

buttonColor.label: Button colour
buttonColor.description: Any CSS colour. Leave empty for WhatsApp green (#25D366).

businessHoursEnabled.label: Show business hours
businessHoursEnabled.description: Shows an Open / Closed badge and, when closed, still lets visitors leave a message.

schedule.label: Weekly schedule
schedule.description: JSON list of opening windows. Shape: [{"days": [1,2,3,4,5], "open": "09:00", "close": "17:00"}]. Days: 0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday. A close time at or before the open time runs past midnight.

holidays.label: Holidays and exceptions
holidays.description: JSON list of closed days. Shape: [{"date": "2026-12-25", "label": "Christmas Day"}] or a range: [{"from": "2026-12-20", "to": "2026-12-31", "label": "Holiday break"}]. The label shows on the badge while closed.

businessTimezone.label: Time zone
businessTimezone.description: Used to decide whether the business is open right now. Leave empty to use the site's time zone.

openLabel.label: Open badge text
openLabel.description: Custom text for the open badge. Leave empty for 'Open now'.

closedLabel.label: Closed badge text
closedLabel.description: Custom text for the closed badge. Leave empty for 'Closed — opens <day time>' when the next opening is known.

closedExtra.label: Extra closed line
closedExtra.description: Optional second line under the closed badge, e.g. 'We reply when we reopen.'

openColor.label: Open badge colour
openColor.description: Hex colour for the open badge. Leave empty for green.

closedColor.label: Closed badge colour
closedColor.description: Hex colour for the closed badge. Leave empty for amber.

departments.label: Departments
departments.description: JSON list of routing chips. Shape: [{"name": "Sales", "number": "+233201234567", "icon": "💼"}]. With two or more, visitors pick who to chat with; the icon is optional.

catalogUrl.label: Catalog link
catalogUrl.description: Your WhatsApp Business catalog deep link (https://wa.me/c/...). Shows a 'Browse products' chip in the panel.

leadFormEnabled.label: Show a pre-chat lead form
leadFormEnabled.description: Asks for a name and consent before the chat opens. The details go into the visitor's own WhatsApp message — the plugin stores nothing.

leadInterests.label: Lead form interests
leadInterests.description: One per line. Each becomes an option in the lead form's interest selector. Leave empty for no selector.

leadConsentText.label: Lead form consent line
leadConsentText.description: The sentence the visitor agrees to before continuing. Required while the lead form is on.
leadConsentText.default: I agree that my name and message will be sent to this business over WhatsApp.

analyticsEnabled.label: Count widget interactions
analyticsEnabled.description: Counts button opens, preset taps and sends as bare numbers. No IP address, phone number, visitor id or cookie is stored.

analyticsPages.label: Count which pages open the widget
analyticsPages.description: Adds the page path (never the query string) to the open counter, so you can see which pages start chats. Aggregate only — still no visitor data.

nudgeEnabled.label: Show a nudge bubble
nudgeEnabled.description: A small teaser appears near the button after a delay, inviting the visitor to chat. It never shows once they have opened the panel themselves.

nudgeDelaySeconds.label: Nudge delay (seconds)
nudgeDelaySeconds.description: How long to wait before the teaser appears. 5 to 300 seconds.

nudgeText.label: Nudge text
nudgeText.description: The teaser line. Keep it short.
nudgeText.default: 👋 Need help? We're here to chat.

nudgeMode.label: Show the nudge
nudgeMode.description: Once per page load, or once per day — the day mode remembers the dismissal in the visitor's browser only (a single date flag, nothing else).

widgetLanguage.label: Widget language
widgetLanguage.description: Language of the widget's own text. 'Visitor's browser' uses each visitor's browser language when a translation exists.

pageRules.label: Page rules
pageRules.description: Optional JSON list. Each rule changes the welcome message and quick replies on matching pages. Shape: [{"pattern": "/pricing", "welcome": "Want a quote?", "presets": ["Send pricing"]}]. Patterns are anchored path globs matched in order: /pricing matches that page exactly, /pricing/* matches every page below it, and ? stands for one character.

agentName.label: Agent name
agentName.description: Name shown in the chat header. Leave empty for the generic 'Chat with us'.

agentRole.label: Agent role
agentRole.description: Optional line under the agent name, e.g. 'Sales at Brayne'.

agentPhoto.label: Agent photo URL
agentPhoto.description: A same-site media path (/media/...) or https image URL for the chat header. Leave empty for the emoji avatar.

utmPropagation.label: Append UTM tags to messages
utmPropagation.description: Adds the page's utm_source, utm_medium and utm_campaign to the visitor's prefilled message, so you can see where a lead came from. Nothing is stored by the plugin.
